name: Qwen-Audio-3.1 ASR, TTS and Realtime APIs widen to 59, 65 and 53 languages with Chinese dialect support
title: Qwen-Audio-3.1 ASR, TTS and Realtime APIs widen to 59, 65 and 53 languages with Chinese dialect support
summary: Alibaba's hosted Qwen-Audio-3.1 speech endpoints now cover 59 languages plus 8 Chinese dialects for recognition, 65 languages plus 6 dialects for synthesis, and 53 plus 6 for realtime voice, selectable by language hint in the API. Useful for voice agents that must handle dialect speech; no new weights or accuracy tables came with it.
